title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: Version 1.5.0 consolidates the FlowMLLab course through Week 13: 33 notebooks, 19 PDF lectures, numerical solvers, research-data audits and retained scientific-ML evidence. Additions include specification-first AI-assisted scientific software, sparse sensing and modal forecasting, cylinder state estimation, shock/vortex identification, real DSMC moment reconstruction, classical scattering, and streamfunction cavity PINNs. Four restartable Unity A100 runs cover Reynolds numbers 100 and 400 with depth-to-width ratios 1 and 2 using Adam followed by SSBroyden2. Square cases pass declared near-matched CFD screening gates; deep cases lack matched raw reference fields. Loss histories retain independent full-domain and corner residuals, including deterioration. Research-derived data are attributed separately from new course code and fits. Existing data defects, reference limitations and pilot status remain documented. Software is MIT licensed; dataset and upstream-code permissions are individually scoped.
